prompt: GNU diff expand-tabs encoding error column width treatment
answer:
For `--expand-tabs` (`-t`), GNU `diff`:

- Consults the locale to determine each character’s column width.
- Treats each encoding error—an input byte not part of any character—as occupying one column.
- Uses those widths when expanding tabs to preserve alignment.

The manual warns that these assumptions can be incorrect for encoding errors and non-ASCII characters, so complex input may not align properly.
